format: HPID PACO object-conditioned part baseline evaluation
evidence_scope: Object-conditioned images with oracle object crop/root. Part names and masks are unavailable during inference; the retrieved object-part inventory supplies text prompts.
baseline_interpretation: CLIPSeg object-part prompting in the one-stage open-vocabulary part-segmentation style used by OV-PARTS baselines. Connected components are evaluated as part instances.
